mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 59 degrees and an air quality index of 52. The moon is in its Waxing Gibbous phase. If you are an early bird, the space station will be visible tomorrow morning starting at 4:59 AM, rising in the West over Mount Horeb and traveling toward the Northeast near the Home Depot, reaching halfway up the sky. Tonight's low will be 49 degrees with no rain predicted.

The Mark Drive reconstruction project is moving along with utility work complete, and residents are reminded that the city offers an Eye-On-Water program to monitor usage. Additionally, the senior center is accepting meal orders daily.

There is plenty to do in town today, including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, ART House 360 opens tomorrow night, and Hop Haus hosts trivia tomorrow as well.
On October 15, 2026, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after reports of dangerous driving behavior; no injuries were reported.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight.
